text: We first need to understand. <break time="0.8s" /> The short but hidden history behind the plastics industry. <break time="0.8s" /> And how it became deeply rooted. <break time="0.8s" /> In our daily lives. <break time="0.8s" /> Before plastic. <break time="0.8s" /> People lived more sustainably. <break time="0.8s" /> With far fewer waste problems. <break time="0.8s" /> Than we face today. <break time="0.8s" /> However. <break time="0.8s" /> After the invention of plastic. <break time="0.8s" /> Its rapid adoption during World War II. <break time="0.8s" /> And its explosion into consumer goods. <break time="0.8s" /> Plastic was everywhere. <break time="0.8s" /> The growing industry came to symbolize. <break time="0.8s" /> The convenience and prosperity of the American dream. <break time="0.8s" /> This dream came with a price. <break time="0.8s" /> Over time. <break time="0.8s" /> People began to notice the environmental impact. <break time="0.8s" /> And the early seeds of todays environmental movement were planted. <break time="0.8s" /> However. <break time="0.8s" /> The plastics industry was quick to counter these concerns. <break time="0.8s" /> Launching campaigns. <break time="0.8s" /> That presented recycling as the solution to all our problems. <break time="0.8s" /> They pushed the idea that pollution was the fault of consumers. <break time="0.8s" /> Not the corporations flooding the market with plastic.
